about: Which sync_outcomes rows get a freshness chip in the one-page header (onepage/view.cjs). Only the sources listed here get a chip, in this order. A child row (an internal sync step) has no chip of its own: it rolls up into its parent, and a failing child turns the parent amber (red when the parent itself failed) and is named in the parent chip's tooltip. An unlisted row named '<parent>_…' rolls up into that parent. Any other unlisted row is hidden while it is ok and shown as its own red chip when it fails, so a failure never disappears. Rules only, no data.
